subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved with documentation and /help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: The central Shift+Enter behavior is already dependency-backed, but a configurable send/newline preference would add public product/config surface under the repository's high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs/web/tui.md and TUI /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Define an approved TUI config, CLI, or keybindings.json bridge into pi-tui keybindings and cover both default compatibility and custom send/newline behavior.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's shipped newline support as sufficient and intentionally decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs/web/tui.md and TUI /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest prior issue review and feature-history connection to the TUI wrapper, docs, submit path, and product boundary.
